Xe tải hạng nhẹ thường là xe tải cỡ nhỏ.en: The light class truck is usually small-sized or just loaded from 1-7 tons. It depends, though, on each country that the load-based classification also differs. In the United States, for example, the light-class truck regulations only carry a maximum mass of 6.3 tons.
Xe tải hạng nhẹ thường là xe tải cỡ nhỏ.zh: 轻级货车通常规模小或刚从1-7吨装上. 然而,基于负载的分类也取决于每个国家。 例如,在美国,轻型货车条例只载有6.3吨的最高重量.

Xe tải hạng nặng là dòng xe chịu được tả.en: Heavy truck is a very large load load line, usually from 16 to 40 tons depending on traffic infrastructure. Heavyweight trucks are mainly used for long-distance transport routes that have large quantities of goods or mass. This kind of car usually has a moonc to pull containers. Of course the rent of heavy-class trucks was also quite high in line compared to other trucks.
Xe tải hạng nặng là dòng xe chịu được tả.zh: 重型卡车是一条非常大的负载线,通常根据交通基础设施的不同从16吨到40吨. 重量级货车主要用于拥有大量货物或质量的长途运输路线. 这种车通常有一个月球C来拉容器. 当然,与其他卡车相比,重型卡车的租金也相当高。

Xe tải siêu trường siêu trọng thường phụ.en: Superweight trucks often serve private transports for special goods, such as: building materials, mining, mineral,... These are all very heavy goods, which cannot be carried by airplane or motorcycle.
Xe tải siêu trường siêu trọng thường phụ.zh: 超重货车经常为特殊货物的私人运输服务,例如:建材,采矿,矿物,. 这些都是非常重的货物,不能用飞机或摩托车载运。

Xe tải thùng kín đúng như tên gọi, được.en: The box truck is exactly what it is called, which is well designed to protect better goods. This type of car is often used to move valuable goods, limited maximum influence from external weather.
Xe tải thùng kín đúng như tên gọi, được.zh: 箱型货车正是它被称作的货车,它设计良好是为了保护更好的货物. 这种车型常被用来移动贵重货物,来自外部天气的最大影响有限.

The barrel truck covered the hood is used to carry a variety of goods. It is possible to carry building materials, items brought up from lifts, cranes, if extra tarp can carry other goods that need to be preserved except raw goods, moving fresh food.
Đây là loại xe có dạng thùng lửng, nghĩa.zh: 这种车型有活浮,意为半个管子并高于油布来为车内产生开阔的空气. 被罩住的管状卡车被用来运载各种货物. 如果多余的油布能够运载除生料外需要保存的其他货物,移动新鲜食品,可以携带起重机,起重机带来的建筑材料,物品.
